▪ The 15% program deposit is always non-refundable.
▪ Withdrawal between final payment due date and 30 days prior to participant arrival will incur a penalty of 50% per participant.
▪ Withdrawal between 29 days and 1 day before the start of a program will incur a penalty of 75% per participant.
▪ Withdrawal at any point upon arrival or after the program start will result in no refund.
Are there any visa requirements for U.S. travelers to Spain?
U.S. citizens can enter Spain for tourism or educational purposes without a visa for stays of up to 90 days. However, if your trip exceeds 90 days, a visa may be required. We advise checking the latest travel requirements with the Spanish consulate before departure.
Do I need vaccinations before traveling to Spain?
Currently, there are no mandatory vaccinations required for travelers from the U.S. to Spain. However, we recommend staying up-to-date on routine vaccines and checking the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) website for any travel-specific health advisories.
Is there a required skill level to participate?
This program is open to players of all skill levels, from beginners to advanced. The training will be tailored to each group’s abilities, and the coaches ensure each participant receives the attention needed to improve their skills.
What should I pack for the trip?
*   Comfortable athletic wear for training (appropriate football gear including cleats).  
*   Casual clothes for sightseeing and downtime.  
*   A jacket or sweater (depending on the season).  
*   Any personal items you may need (toiletries, medications, etc.).  
*   A travel adapter for electronics (Spain uses 230V, 50Hz with European plugs).  
*   A small backpack for daily use.
What is the group size for the program?
The ideal group size is between 15 and 50 students or players. Larger groups may be accommodated, but this could affect logistics, such as training and accommodation arrangements.
Is there a medical team available during the trip?
Yes, there is a professional medical team available at the Sevilla FC training facilities. Additionally, the travel insurance would cover any medical emergencies or additional needs while abroad.
What happens if a player or participant gets injured?

# Train Like a Professional
## Sevilla FC Academy Soccer
Our team will coordinate with local hospitals or health services. Our travel insurance covers medical treatment abroad.
**What safety measures are implemented during the program?**
The safety of our participants is our top priority. Strict measures are implemented, including travel medical insurance, support staff available 24/7, and coordination with local authorities to ensure safety during all activities.
**Does the program offer a certificate or recognition?**
At the end of the program, participants will receive a certificate of participation issued by the Sevilla FC Academy, which can serve as recognition of their training and international experience.
**Do I need to speak Spanish to participate in the program?**
No advanced Spanish language skills are required. The program is designed to be accessible to international students, and the coaching staff and guides will be available to communicate in English. Additionally, activities will help you learn about Spanish culture during your stay.
**Can I join the program if I am part of a small group?**
Yes, the program is open to both large and small groups. If you are part of a smaller group, we can still accommodate your participation, provided the minimum number of participants is met.
**What is the start date for the program?**
The start date of the program varies depending on the duration and type of program chosen. We have options available year-round, including summer vacation, allowing the program to fit your academic calendar.
**What kind of cultural activities could be included in the program?**
Participants will have the chance to explore the city of Seville, visiting iconic sites such as the **Alcázar of Seville**, the **Seville Cathedral**, **Plaza de España**, and the **Triana district**. Additionally, cultural activities such as flamenco classes and cooking experiences can be organized.
Are parents and friends allowed to travel with the students?
Parents and friends can join this program upon request in the proposal. Parents can enjoy the cultural activities and explore Seville while their children participate in the training program.
**Can I get more information before making a decision?**
Absolutely! If you need more details about the program, dates, pricing, or any other questions, please don’t hesitate to contact us. We are available by email or phone and will be happy to assist you with any queries.

### Climate change initiatives

Singapore recognises that climate change in the decades ahead will have major implications for the island-nation. It has taken a three-prong approach to the issue - researching how the nation will be affected in specific details, implementing mitigation measures and adapting to the coming changes. For the research, a Centre for Climate Research Singapore (CCRS) has been established.[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geography_of_Singapore#cite_note-20)
The government estimates that $100 billion will need to be spent over a 100-year time frame to address the issue. The country's transport policy continues to focus on a "car-lite" future with most commuters using public transportation (MRT trains, buses, taxis) instead. ### Climate change initiatives
[edit]
Singapore recognises that climate change in the decades ahead will have major implications for the island-nation. It has taken a three-prong approach to the issue - researching how the nation will be affected in specific details, implementing mitigation measures and adapting to the coming changes. For the research, a Centre for Climate Research Singapore (CCRS) has been established.[[20]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geography_of_Singapore#cite_note-20)
The government estimates that $100 billion will need to be spent over a 100-year time frame to address the issue. In the 2020 budget, it has set aside an initial $5 billion towards a Coastline and Flood Protection Fund.[[21]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geography_of_Singapore#cite_note-21) For the population, it will provide incentives for owners to convert to electric vehicles (EVs), like rebates on the Additional Registration fees and expanding the EV charging network. By 2040, it expects to phase out petrol and diesel (internal combustion engine) vehicles. The country's transport policy continues to focus on a "car-lite" future with most commuters using public transportation (MRT trains, buses, taxis) instead. [[22]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geography_of_Singapore#cite_note-22)
Singapore is the first country in Southeast Asia to levy a carbon tax, at $5 per ton, applicable for its largest carbon-emitting corporations that produce more than 25,000 tons of carbon dioxide per year.[[23]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geography_of_Singapore#cite_note-23) To reduce the country's dependence on fossil fuels, it is building one of the world's largest floating solar farms at Tengeh Reservoir in Tuas, with a capacity of 60MW.[[24]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geography_of_Singapore#cite_note-24)
Although Singapore does not observe daylight saving time (DST), it follows the UTC+8 time zone, one hour ahead of the typical zone for its geographical location.[[25]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Geography_of_Singapore#cite_note-25)

****Why we chose it:****ESA is a strong pick for parents who want more than just training drills. Children get to join local leagues and numerous international tournaments, gaining valuable match experience beyond training. ESA also stands out for the number of overseas tournaments it offers. Led by former professional and international players, the academy places strong emphasis on character building, helping children develop confidence, discipline and teamwork alongside their football skills. **Price:** From $500 per term. Register here.

**Locations:** Multiple football training fields in Singapore including Bishan, Orchard and Tampines
**Price:** From $45 per session. Register here.

**Ages:** 4 to 18 years (separate Girls & Boys training)
**Locations:** SkyPark Arena @ Holland, 102 Ulu Pandan Road, Singapore 597806
**Price:** From $55 per session. Register here.

Where does Sevilla FC play its games?
Sevilla FC plays its home games at the Ramón Sánchez-Pizjuán Stadium, located in Seville, Spain. The Ramón Sánchez-Pizjuán is a stadium that has been the home of Sevilla FC since its inauguration in 1958.
